title: Xbox 360 Startup
blurb: A swooshing green orb, and an entire console generation announcing itself. The Xbox 360 arrived in 2005 and the boot sound came to mean Halo nights, Live parties full of people you had never met, and a genuine statistical likelihood of the red ring of death. For millions it is simply the sound of adolescence — of games arriving on discs, of headsets that crackled, of an era when a friends list was short enough to actually know. Play it for instant, uncomplicated nostalgia and a small flicker of hardware anxiety.
origin: The boot sound from the Xbox 360 (Microsoft, 2005).
